Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-screen 16:9 background painting for Aequilibrium, a quiet realistic narrative game.
Input images: the referenced bookshop-day.webp and district-street.webp are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets.
Primary request: paint a DIFFERENT room in the same world: the rear duty desk of a modest old coastal Chinese bookshop on a winter night. A worn scarf hangs on a wall hook. On the left foreground wooden desk sit a tall old thermos, an enamel cup and a pale blank paper with a simple unlabeled grid, no writing. A small shaded desk lamp casts a confined warm pool. The wooden-framed window carries thin condensation, beyond it cold blue-grey night and subtle evergreen silhouettes. A few books on a low shelf, dark worn floorboards, plaster walls. Keep the center and right foreground open for later game characters and dialogue overlays. Eye-level human camera, believable single-point perspective, unoccupied.
Style/medium: restrained hand-painted cinematic storyboard realism, fine gouache/oil brushwork, subtle paper tooth, natural material detail; visual match to both references. Slate greys, tobacco brown, muted moss green, tiny warm amber light. Not photographic CGI, not anime.
Composition: one complete landscape image, horizontal 16:9, 1672 by 941 or closest, no collage or frames.
Constraints: absolutely NO people, readable text, lettering, UI, watermark, logos, fantasy effects, excessive bloom, orange/teal grading, dramatic light beams, stock-trading displays. Cozy but sober and lived-in. The thermos and scarf clearly signal winter without snow indoors.
assets.inspection: Complete independent landscape painting; no people or readable text; painterly material and restrained palette matched to references.
